name: @stress-carve/deploy
description: Ships apps/web/dist to Cloudflare (Workers + Static Assets) with the cf CLI. See README.md.

scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm build:web && cf build --mode production && node check.mjs --build-output && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode production --dry-run
scripts.deploy:cf: pnpm build:web && cf build --mode production && node check.mjs --build-output && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode production
